name: sidecar-gazala-cq-nobots
description: Gazala Conquest with no bots and 5x tickets: open desert for timing a control point's capture against the page's capture-ring estimate (features/capture-progress-rings). The neutral 0PEN_BASE_crossing (radius 50) is 290 m east of the Axis village's spawns; the Allied village (team 2) is 320 m south of the crossing's.
human: No client: `node lab/capture_probe.mjs 127.0.0.1:<port> capture.ndjson` joins as team 1 at the Axis village, walks into 0PEN_BASE_crossing and stands. A second player joining restarts the round, so join an idle one first (STOP=100000).
